name: Bamenda
description: Bamenda is the capital of Cameroon's Northwest Region, in the Grassfields. Individual palaces, markets or ring-road stops are not listed here until each has its own sourced site sheet. Security and access conditions must be checked from official advisories, which this file does not store.
culture: The Northwest Grassfields are known for chefferies. This entry only records Bamenda as the regional capital, not unsourced palace inventories.

sources.title: Première visite
